reasons: Both give nearly identical, syntactically valid sequence diagrams with par/alt/loop, correct async webhook after 3DS, a verification step before the DB update, and the same well-hedged caveat about YooKassa not using HMAC signatures. A adds the 200 OK webhook acknowledgement with a useful idempotency note and keeps labels slightly terser, while B adds the user actor, delivery of the FCM push to the app, and practical rendering fallbacks for Confluence plugins. These offsetting strengths leave neither clearly better.
